generator: tools/audio/build_audio6.py (procedural synthesis: sfx6.py, music6.py; same toolkit + loudness conventions as assets/audio .. audio4)

bgm_city.notes: busy upbeat living-city theme (126 bpm shuffle, 61 s), A A B A like bgm_village: the village hook verbatim, made busier; B = the village B melody on flute. Daytime in the city districts (logistics, bank, police). ~21 MB as decoded PCM: load lazily, Audio.playMusic('bgm_city') crossfades.

bgm_chase.notes: comic chase gallop (168 bpm, 23 s): play while police chase a thief (or a fire engine races), then playMusic back to the previous theme on arrest. Sneaky tiptoe bars 9-12.

amb_fire_big.notes: building fire: warm roar + crackle + snaps + 'fwoosh' licks (cosy cartoon, no scary highs). setAmbience('amb_fire_big', 0..1) by distance x fire size; fade out with the steam hiss.

amb_construction.notes: building site across the street (hammering, saw, drill, clanks, far reverse beeps, a worker's call). setAmbience by distance to any construction / rebuild site.

amb_bank.notes: inside the bank: hushed marble-hall murmur, footsteps, note counter, number-ticket 'ding-dong', stamp. setAmbience 0..1 while the bank's inside is revealed / the camera is near it.

amb_warehouse.notes: inside the logistics centre: conveyor hum + roller rattle, boxes bumping, far forklift reverse beeps, tape gun, big hall. setAmbience 0..1 while revealed / near.

sfx_siren_fire.notes: positional mono loop (kind ambience, like audio3 sfx_truck_engine): Audio.setAmbience('sfx_siren_fire', 0..1) by distance to the nearest fire engine, or sm.add('sfx_siren_fire', {loop: true}) per fire engine; retro two-tone 'nee-naw' (D5 / A4, 0.5 s each, round, not piercing). Start on dispatch, fade out ~1 s after arrival. Use rate 1.0; a Doppler-ish rate 1.03 -> 0.97 as it passes is cute.

sfx_siren_police.notes: positional mono loop (kind ambience, like audio3 sfx_truck_engine): Audio.setAmbience('sfx_siren_police', 0..1) by distance to the nearest police car, or sm.add('sfx_siren_police', {loop: true}) per police car; toy 'wee-oo' glide (C5 - F5, 0.6 s cycle). During a chase; stop on arrest.

sfx_hose_spray.notes: positional mono loop (kind ambience, like audio3 sfx_truck_engine): Audio.setAmbience('sfx_hose_spray', 0..1) by distance to the nearest spraying firefighter, or sm.add('sfx_hose_spray', {loop: true}) per spraying firefighter; loop while anim spray_hose plays (fx_hose_stream). One instance is enough for several hoses (raise its volume a little).

sfx_excavator.notes: positional mono loop (kind ambience, like audio3 sfx_truck_engine): Audio.setAmbience('sfx_excavator', 0..1) by distance to the nearest excavator, or sm.add('sfx_excavator', {loop: true}) per excavator; rate 0.85 idle / moving, 1.0 working, 1.12 while anims.dig plays; add sfx_demolish_crunch on each dig frame.

sfx_comic_fight.notes: positional mono loop (kind ambience, like audio3 sfx_truck_engine): Audio.setAmbience('sfx_comic_fight', 0..1) by distance to the nearest fx_fight_cloud, or sm.add('sfx_comic_fight', {loop: true}) per fx_fight_cloud; cartoon scuffle (bonk, pow, biff, swish, boing, tiny 'hai!'). Loop while the dust cloud is up (2-4 s), stop with a sfx_police_whistle or a laugh.

sfx_fire_flare.notes: flames burst from a window (fx_fire_window / fire start / flare-up when the hose stops).

sfx_steam_hiss.notes: the fire goes out under the hose (fx_steam_puff); fade amb_fire_big out over the hiss.

sfx_collapse_soft.notes: a burnt shell settles into a ruin (swap the sprite to ruin_* on 'flumph'); cute, no violence.

sfx_demolish_crunch.notes: excavator bucket bites the ruin: play on the bucket's contact frame of anims.dig (fx_demolish_dust).

sfx_coin_count.notes: teller counts coins: deposits / withdrawals / interest paid.

sfx_stamp.notes: rubber stamp on a ledger: settlement at the logistics counter, loan approved, passbook entry (ui_icon_settle).

sfx_vault_door.notes: the bank vault opens (anims.vault, 8 f): play on frame 0; the door swings 1.25 -> 2.15 s (frames 4-7 at ~4 fps).

sfx_forklift_beep.notes: forklift reversing (three C6 beeps). Repeat every ~1.3 s while a forklift drives backwards; volume by distance.

sfx_police_whistle.notes: officer spots a thief / stops a scuffle ('pweet! pweeeeet!').

sfx_crowd_gasp.notes: onlookers 'h-oooh!' (fire breaks out, thief runs, roof collapses). Surprised, not scared.

sfx_crowd_cheer_small.notes: fire out / thief caught / new building opens: 'hoo-ray!', finger whistle, applause (differs from audio2 sfx_cheer).

sfx_cuffs_click.notes: arrest: toy cuffs (start anim arrested_walk on 'latch').

sfx_fire_alarm_bell.notes: fire reported (fire_alarm_post / fire station bell), before the siren starts. Friendly, not shrill.

sfx_moving_truck.notes: moving truck arrives and opens (anims.unload: ramp + door); drive in with audio3 sfx_truck_engine.

sfx_box_drop.notes: cardboard box / crate set down (movers, warehouse pickers, deliveries). For variety play the group sfx_box (3 boxes) with rate 0.92-1.1; throttle ~120 ms.

sfx_box_drop_2.notes: variant: small box with tins / toys clinking inside (group sfx_box).

sfx_box_drop_3.notes: variant: big heavy box, deeper thump + short scrape (group sfx_box).

sfx_newspaper.notes: the morning paper '솔방울 신문' opens (ui_newspaper) / a resident reads the paper.
